'''Ruchikila''' was a [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Ruchikila was [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] who was [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Jedi academy|academy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="CWGS" />

[[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] oversaw Ruchikila's [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|clan's]] training. During a session of blindfolded [[seeker]] testing, Yoda received an urgent message from Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his former apprentice, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]]. On an [[Battle of Lanteeb|undercover mission]], the two Jedi's request was met without hesitation and Master Yoda left Ruchikila and the other Initiates to test by themselves for a time.<ref name="CWGS" />
